developer_session_bootstrap.name: Bootstrap Session Intelligence Golden Scenario
developer_session_bootstrap.description: Developer and CI helper: start or stop the isolated server-owned Runtime Session required to enable the explicitly selected Session Intelligence Golden Scenario. It supports the six approved original Session Intelligence Golden Scenarios. It does not execute the scenario, generate a DJMoment or expose Runtime, Planner, Knowledge, Performance Memory or Broadcast-token internals.

action.name: Action
action.description: Start the isolated Session or stop and clean it up.

developer_session_scenario_driver.name: Run Session Intelligence Golden Scenario
developer_session_scenario_driver.description: Developer and CI helper: run the explicitly selected approved Golden Scenario through the existing server-owned Runtime after developer_session_bootstrap has started its isolated Session. It supplies only the fixed deterministic Track Insight input or inputs and does not invoke Planner, Knowledge or DJ Moment Engine internals directly.

developer_session_capture.name: Capture Session Intelligence Golden Scenario
developer_session_capture.description: Developer and CI helper: create one immutable, read-only observation of the completed approved Golden Scenario Runtime execution. It captures no credentials, mutable Runtime objects or Planner internals.

golden_qualification.name: Run Golden Qualification Foundation
golden_qualification.description: Developer and future-CI helper: execute the canonical deterministic server-side qualification path for all executable Session Intelligence Golden Scenarios. It reuses Bootstrap, Scenario Driver, immutable Capture and Structural Validation, then cleans every isolated Session. It validates only Planner, Knowledge, DJMoment, Presentation, Session Flow and renderer-safe Broadcast projections; it does not test a Renderer Host, visual output, audio, TTS or hardware.

include_advisory_metrics.name: Include advisory metrics
include_advisory_metrics.description: Add the bounded, read-only Intelligence Quality Metrics v1 projection to this report. It does not affect qualification success or failure.

golden_smoke.name: Run Golden Smoke
golden_smoke.description: Developer and future-CI helper: run the smallest approved Golden Smoke selection, currently SI-GOLDEN-001, through the existing Golden Qualification Foundation. It reuses the same Bootstrap, Scenario Driver, immutable Capture, Structural Validation and bounded report. This service does not implement a CI workflow or change Golden Scenario behavior.

include_advisory_metrics.name: Include advisory metrics
include_advisory_metrics.description: Add the bounded, read-only Intelligence Quality Metrics v1 projection to this report. It does not affect qualification success or failure.

golden_regression.name: Run Golden Regression
golden_regression.description: Local developer helper: run the complete approved Session Intelligence contract, SI-GOLDEN-001 through SI-GOLDEN-006, through the existing Golden Qualification Foundation. It reuses the same Bootstrap, Scenario Driver, Runtime, immutable Capture, Structural Validation, cleanup and bounded report. This fixed profile accepts no scenario selection or configuration, and does not implement a CI workflow or release gate.

include_advisory_metrics.name: Include advisory metrics
include_advisory_metrics.description: Add the bounded, read-only Intelligence Quality Metrics v1 projection to this report. It does not affect qualification success or failure.

test_tts.name: Test DJ announcement
test_tts.description: Developer test: send a standalone DJ announcement to the paired DJConnect device. Home Assistant tries to create a temporary WAV or MP3 audio_url through the configured TTS engine; if that fails, DJConnect sends text only so the device can display the announcement.

dj_response_text.name: DJ announcement text

test_command.name: Test full text command
test_command.description: Developer test: use the same text-command route as the DJConnect device. Text goes through Home Assistant to a DJConnect intent, can optionally start playback through Spotify Direct or Music Assistant, and then sends the DJ announcement to the ESP device. Current-track questions and direct playback controls are handled by Home Assistant without client-side provider credentials or playback backend logic.

command_text.name: Command text

test_ptt_text.name: Test PTT text flow
test_ptt_text.description: Developer test: start exactly after STT conversion. Enter the natural language sentence the user said; DJConnect runs intent parsing, selected backend search/playback where supported, DJ announcement generation with text/audio, and sends the result back to the connected DJConnect device/client.

command_text.name: Natural language text

test_apns_push.name: Test APNs push
test_apns_push.description: Developer diagnostic: inspect DJConnect APNs push readiness for iOS, macOS or Apple Watch clients. By default this returns decision, relay, registration and last error details without sending a push. Set send to true to attempt a privacy-safe test push through the DJConnect central relay.

explicit_user_request.name: Explicit user request
explicit_user_request.description: Leave on for manual tests so Ask DJ push policy allows the event when otherwise valid.

push_register.name: APNs push registration
push_register.description: Developer helper: register an iOS, macOS or Apple Watch APNs token through the same backend path as /api/djconnect/v1/push/register. Home Assistant forwards the token to the DJConnect central relay and stores only compact registration status. If registration reports missing_bootstrap_proof, a paired Apple client should obtain a trusted central-issued short-lived bootstrap proof from the Apple pairing issuer and retry registration with bootstrap_proof. HA does not locally mint, request or store bootstrap proofs; /api/djconnect/v1/push/bootstrap only reports bootstrap_proof_unavailable.

push_token.name: Push token
push_token.description: APNs device token from the Apple client. This is forwarded to the relay and must not be shared in logs.

locale.description: Optional client locale, for example nl or en.

bootstrap_proof.name: Bootstrap proof
bootstrap_proof.description: Optional short-lived Apple client bootstrap proof from the trusted Apple pairing issuer, used transiently to mint a DJConnect install token when needed.

push_unregister.name: APNs push unregistration
push_unregister.description: Developer helper: unregister an iOS, macOS or Apple Watch APNs token through the same backend path as /api/djconnect/v1/push/unregister. Home Assistant clears local compact registration status when the relay accepts the request.

push_token.name: Push token
push_token.description: APNs device token from the Apple client. This is forwarded to the relay and must not be shared in logs.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: DJConnect Apple client id, for example djconnect-ios-ABCDEFGHIJKL.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: ios, macos or watchos. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: Optional HA user id for the same user-scoped push registration path as Ask DJ.

ask_dj.name: Ask DJ
ask_dj.description: Developer/raw Ask DJ text request. Home Assistant handles intent routing, Music DNA, selected-backend/Home Assistant actions and informational answers. Use Ask DJ message for the app-style server-side chat history flow.

music_dna_key.name: Memory key
music_dna_key.description: Optional client-suggested Music DNA key. Home Assistant may normalize it.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Supported DJConnect client type such as ios, macos, watchos or raspberry_pi. The Windows app is retired.

client_message_id.name: Client message ID
client_message_id.description: Optional idempotency key supplied by the client.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

ask_dj_message.name: Ask DJ message
ask_dj_message.description: App-style Ask DJ chat message using the same server-side history sync route as /api/djconnect/v1/ask_dj/message. Stores the user request and assistant response in the authenticated Home Assistant user's Ask DJ history.

client_message_id.name: Client message ID
client_message_id.description: Optional idempotency key; repeated ids return the existing exchange for the same HA user.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional client-suggested Music DNA key. Home Assistant may normalize it.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Supported DJConnect client type such as ios, macos, watchos or raspberry_pi. The Windows app is retired.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

ask_dj_idle_suggestion.name: Ask DJ idle suggestion
ask_dj_idle_suggestion.description: Return an Ask DJ idle suggestion for the resolved user/client context and append the assistant message to server-side Ask DJ history when successful.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to use for the suggestion context.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Supported DJConnect client type such as ios, macos, watchos or raspberry_pi. The Windows app is retired.

ask_dj_history.name: Ask DJ history
ask_dj_history.description: Return server-side Ask DJ chat history using the same route as /api/djconnect/v1/ask_dj/history. Use since_revision to fetch only newer history when syncing a client.

since_revision.name: Since revision
since_revision.description: Optional history revision to fetch changes after.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Supported DJConnect client type such as ios, macos, watchos or raspberry_pi. The Windows app is retired.

track_insight.name: Track Insight
track_insight.description: Analyze the currently playing track or an explicit artist/title through the same handler as /api/djconnect/v1/track_insight. The service returns normalized Track Insight JSON with analysis, cache metadata and visual-profile hints, then fires the djconnect_track_insight event for automations and dashboards when successful.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Optional media_player entity to inspect for now-playing metadata.

title.name: Track title
title.description: Optional explicit track title. Provide artist too to analyze a track without now-playing metadata.

album.name: Album
album.description: Optional album name for identity, cache and visual seed.

genres.name: Genres
genres.description: Optional genre list or object from client/backend metadata.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key metadata for this Track Insight context.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional DJConnect device/client id. Leave empty to use the paired client.

music_backend.name: Music backend
music_backend.description: Optional backend hint for cache identity and explicit-track analysis.

force_refresh.name: Force refresh
force_refresh.description: Ignore cached insight and request a fresh analysis.

include_visual_profile.name: Include visual profile
include_visual_profile.description: Include deterministic visualization hints for clients.

include_raw_response.name: Include raw response
include_raw_response.description: Include the raw AI response for developer diagnostics.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

language.name: Language
language.description: Optional language hint, for example en or nl.

vibecast_feed.name: VibeCast feed
vibecast_feed.description: Developer helper: return the same VibeCast bubble feed as /api/djconnect/v1/vibecast for iOS, macOS or Apple Watch clients. The feed uses the current backend playback context and returns short display-ready items when VibeCast is enabled and playback is active.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: iOS, macOS or watchOS client type. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional DJConnect Apple client id. Leave empty to use the paired client.

render_capabilities.name: Render capabilities
render_capabilities.description: Optional comma-separated render capabilities such as bold, emphasis, accent or emoji_safe.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

language.name: Language
language.description: Optional language hint, for example en or nl.

music_discovery_feed.name: Music Discovery feed
music_discovery_feed.description: Developer helper: return the same Music Discovery feed as /api/djconnect/v1/music_discovery for the resolved Music DNA context. Music DNA must be enabled for this user/client context.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to inspect.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

force_refresh.name: Force refresh
force_refresh.description: Ignore the cached discovery feed and rebuild it.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

refresh_music_discovery.name: Refresh Music Discovery
refresh_music_discovery.description: Developer helper: force-refresh the Music Discovery feed through the same route as /api/djconnect/v1/music_discovery/refresh. The backend applies the same server-side refresh rate limit as clients.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to refresh.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

play_music_discovery_item.name: Play Music Discovery item
play_music_discovery_item.description: Developer helper: play a cached Music Discovery item through the same route as /api/djconnect/v1/music_discovery/play and record positive Music DNA feedback when playback starts.

discovery_item_id.name: Discovery item ID
discovery_item_id.description: Item id from a Music Discovery feed response.

section_id.name: Section ID
section_id.description: Optional section id from the Music Discovery feed response.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to resolve the cached feed.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

music_discovery_feedback.name: Music Discovery feedback
music_discovery_feedback.description: Developer helper: record negative feedback for a cached Music Discovery item through the same route as /api/djconnect/v1/music_discovery/feedback. This updates compact Music DNA preference signals without starting playback.

discovery_item_id.name: Discovery item ID
discovery_item_id.description: Item id from a Music Discovery feed response.

section_id.name: Section ID
section_id.description: Optional section id from the Music Discovery feed response.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to resolve the cached feed.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

music_dna_profile.name: Music DNA profile
music_dna_profile.description: Return the current structured Music DNA profile through the same backend path as /api/djconnect/v1/music_dna/profile. If Music DNA is not enabled, the profile is empty and enabled is false.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to inspect.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: Optional display name for the requesting client.

set_music_dna_enabled.name: Set Music DNA enabled
set_music_dna_enabled.description: Opt a user/client context in or out of Music DNA through the same backend path as /api/djconnect/v1/music_dna/settings. Disabling Music DNA clears learned Music DNA knowledge and stops future knowledge collection.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether Music DNA may build knowledge for this context.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to update.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: Optional display name for the requesting client.

clear_music_dna.name: Clear Music DNA
clear_music_dna.description: Clear learned Music DNA knowledge through the same backend path as /api/djconnect/v1/music_dna/clear while preserving the current opt-in setting.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to clear.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: Optional display name for the requesting client.

music_dna_export.name: Music DNA export
music_dna_export.description: Export the current Music DNA profile through the same backend path as /api/djconnect/v1/music_dna/export. The response is an importable djconnect.music_dna.export envelope for the resolved Home Assistant user/client context.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to export.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: Optional display name for the requesting client.

app_version.name: App version
app_version.description: Optional requesting app version metadata included in the export envelope.

music_dna_import.name: Music DNA import
music_dna_import.description: Import a Music DNA export envelope through the same backend path as /api/djconnect/v1/music_dna/import. Music DNA must already be enabled for the resolved Home Assistant user/client context.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Music DNA export envelope or profile payload to import.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key to import into.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving Music DNA.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: Optional display name for the requesting client.

clear_ask_dj_history.name: Clear Ask DJ history
clear_ask_dj_history.description: Clear server-side Ask DJ history for the authenticated Home Assistant user. The backend increases clear_revision and history_revision so clients know they must clear local chat cache.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type used when resolving memory.

ask_dj_history_state.name: Ask DJ history state
ask_dj_history_state.description: Return compact Ask DJ history sync state, including history_revision, clear_revision and whether a client should clear local chat cache.

history_revision.name: History revision
history_revision.description: Last Ask DJ history revision known by the client.

clear_revision.name: Clear revision
clear_revision.description: Last Ask DJ clear revision known by the client.

start_spotify_oauth.name: Start Spotify OAuth
start_spotify_oauth.description: Developer helper: create a Spotify PKCE authorization URL for the Home Assistant Spotify Direct backend. Open the URL, sign in to Spotify, and the callback stores the refresh token in DJConnect. This is not used when Music Assistant is the selected backend.

client_id.name: Spotify Client ID
client_id.description: Spotify Developer App Client ID. Leave empty to use the value from DJConnect options.

ha_base_url.name: Home Assistant external URL
ha_base_url.description: Base URL Spotify can reach after login, preferably your Nabu Casa URL. Leave empty to use the URL from DJConnect options. The full redirect URI is this URL plus /api/djconnect/v1/spotify/callback.

market.name: Spotify market
market.description: Spotify region for search and playback.

scopes.name: Spotify scopes
scopes.description: Spotify OAuth scopes. Leave empty for the default DJConnect scopes.

music_backend_status.name: Music backend status
music_backend_status.description: Developer diagnostic: return the selected DJConnect music backend, capabilities, revision, target player and safe availability/error metadata. Use this to verify Music Assistant selection and target-player readiness from Home Assistant Developer Tools without starting playback.

device_command.name: Send device command
device_command.description: Developer helper: send a command to the paired DJConnect device through the local /api/device/command endpoint using the stored bearer token.

command.name: Command
command.description: Local DJConnect command, for example status, next, previous, set_volume, set_output, start_playlist, ask_dj_play_recommendation, set_language or dj_response.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Optional command payload as an object, for example {"value": 35}.

queue.name: Music queue
queue.description: Developer diagnostic: return the current selected-backend queue through the same command route as /api/djconnect/v1/command with command queue. This does not start, stop or mutate playback.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional DJConnect device/client id. Leave empty to use the paired client.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key metadata for the queue request context.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

playlists.name: Music playlists
playlists.description: Developer diagnostic: return selected-backend playlists through the same command route as /api/djconnect/v1/command with command playlists. This does not start, stop or mutate playback.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional DJConnect device/client id. Leave empty to use the paired client.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of playlists to return.

market.name: Market
market.description: Optional Spotify market hint, for example NL or US.

music_dna_key.name: Music DNA key
music_dna_key.description: Optional Music DNA key metadata for the playlists request context.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

playback_status.name: Playback status
playback_status.description: Developer diagnostic: return selected-backend playback status through the same command route as /api/djconnect/v1/command with command status. This does not mutate playback.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional DJConnect device/client id. Leave empty to use the paired client.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

playback_devices.name: Playback devices
playback_devices.description: Developer diagnostic: return selected-backend playback outputs/devices through the same command route as /api/djconnect/v1/command with command devices. This does not mutate playback.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional DJConnect device/client id. Leave empty to use the paired client.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

playback_command.name: Playback command
playback_command.description: Developer helper: send a selected-backend playback command through the same route as /api/djconnect/v1/command. Use for commands such as play, play_uris, pause, next, previous, set_volume, set_output, set_shuffle, set_repeat, seek_relative, save_current_track and current-track favorite commands.

value.name: Value
value.description: Optional command value. Examples are 40 for set_volume, true for set_shuffle, "off" for set_repeat or {"uris":["spotify:track:..."]} for play_uris.

play.name: Start playback
play.description: Only affects commands that support this option. Disabling it is not a dry run: commands such as play can still start music.

client_type.name: Client type
client_type.description: Optional DJConnect client type. Leave empty to use the paired client type.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional DJConnect device/client id. Leave empty to use the paired client.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: Optional response locale, for example en or nl.

refresh_device_info.name: Refresh device info
refresh_device_info.description: Developer helper: fetch /api/device/info from the paired DJConnect device and update Home Assistant status sensors.

reboot_device.name: Reboot device
reboot_device.description: Developer helper: ask the paired DJConnect device to reboot through /api/device/reboot.

forget_device.name: Forget device pairing
forget_device.description: Developer helper: ask the paired DJConnect device to forget its local pairing through /api/device/forget. Re-pair the device afterwards.

profile_export.name: Export profile
profile_export.description: Export the resolved DJConnect Profile without OAuth tokens, provider secrets, Home Assistant tokens, APNs tokens or device tokens.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Optional explicit Profile ID. Device, HA user and fallback resolution are used when omitted.

include_personal_data.name: Include personal data
include_personal_data.description: Include allowed personal references such as Music DNA, mood and likes. Guest-safe/private exports still redact personal state.

household_export.name: Export household
household_export.description: Export household Profile Platform metadata, mappings, backend/account metadata and non-secret configuration. Provider credentials must be re-linked after import.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Optional Profile ID used only for profile resolution/authorization context.

integration_export.name: Export integration
integration_export.description: Export a full non-secret DJConnect integration envelope. Secrets are excluded by default and explicitly marked as excluded in the response.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Optional Profile ID used only for profile resolution/authorization context.

profile_import.name: Import profile
profile_import.description: Import a single DJConnect Profile export. Secret-like fields are rejected and provider accounts must be re-linked where credentials are missing.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing profile with the same ID.

reassign_id.name: Reassign ID
reassign_id.description: Create a new imported Profile ID when the export ID already exists.

household_import.name: Import household
household_import.description: Import a household or full non-secret integration export. Existing profiles are not overwritten unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Allow replacing the existing Profile Platform household state.

clear_profile_state.name: Clear profile state
clear_profile_state.description: Clear selected personal state for the resolved Profile without deleting the Profile.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Optional explicit Profile ID. Device, HA user and fallback resolution are used when omitted.

ask_dj.name: Ask DJ history
ask_dj.description: Clear Ask DJ conversation references/history for this context.

music_dna.name: Music DNA
music_dna.description: Reset Music DNA references/data for this context.

recommendations.name: Recommendations
recommendations.description: Clear recommendation references, likes and dislikes.

all.name: All personal state
all.description: Clear all personal state references without deleting the Profile.
